camel_example: aliyun pvtz DescribeZoneRecords --region cn-hangzhou --Keyword test --ZoneId a96d70eb4ab8ef01503dc54869140000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --UserClientIp '127.0.XX.XX' --Lang en --Tag ecs --SearchMode EXACT
description_en: You can call DescribeZoneRecords to query DNS records for a zone
description_zh: 调用DescribeZoneRecords查询域名解析记录列表
kebab_example: aliyun pvtz describe-zone-records --lang en --keyword test --zone-id a96d70eb4ab8ef01503dc54869140000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --user-client-ip 127.0.XX.XX --tag ecs --search-mode EXACT --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeZoneRecords

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the hostname. The search is not case-sensitive. Use the SearchMode parameter to switch between a fuzzy search and an exact search. The default is an exact search
parameters.help_zh: 主机记录的关键字，不区分大小写。你可已通过设置搜索模式（SearchMode）切换为“模糊搜索”或“精确搜索”，默认为“精确搜索”
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the zone
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置查询的页码，起始值为 1，默认为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数据量，最大值 100，默认为 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The client IP address of the user
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The tag. Valid values:

ecs: Queries the hostnames that are synchronized from ECS instances to the zone.

If you do not specify this parameter, all DNS records in the zone are queried
parameters.help_zh:
标签。取值：

ecs：查询当前Zone同步的ECS主机名记录。
为空：查询当前Zone的解析记录
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The search mode. Valid values:

LIKE: fuzzy search

EXACT: exact search (default)

This parameter is used with the Keyword parameter
parameters.help_zh:
搜索模式。取值：

LIKE：模糊搜索
EXACT：精确搜索（默认）

生效范围：Keyworld字段
parameters.name: search_mode

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

items.description_en: The details of a DNS record

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the DNS record was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the DNS record was created

Priority.description_en: The priority of the MX record

RecordId.description_en: The ID of the DNS record

Status.description_en:
The status of the DNS record. Valid values:

ENABLE: enabled

DISABLE: paused
Status.description_zh:
解析记录状态。描述：

ENABLE：启用

DISABLE：暂停

Type.description_en:
The type of the DNS record. Valid values:

A: maps a domain name to an IPv4 address.

AAAA: maps a domain name to an IPv6 address.

CNAME: maps a domain name to another domain name.

TXT: a text record. The text can be up to 255 characters in length. A TXT record is usually used for Sender Policy Framework (SPF) records to prevent spam.

MX: maps a domain name to the IP address of a mail server.

PTR: maps an IP address to a domain name.

SRV: a service record that specifies the server that provides a specific service
Type.description_zh:
解析记录类型。描述：
A：将域名指向一个IPV4
AAAA：将域名指向一个IPV6
CNAME：将域名指向另一个域名
TXT：文本长度限制255，通常做SPF记录（反垃圾邮件）
MX：将域名指向邮件服务器地址
PTR：将IP地址指向一个域名
SRV：记录提供特定的服务的服务器

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the DNS record was last updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the DNS record was last updated

Weight.description_en: The weight of the record. Valid values: 1 to 100. The default value is 1. DNS requests are distributed to the IP addresses of records based on their weights
Weight.description_zh: 权重值（1-100 内的整数，包括 1 和 100，默认为1），支持对每个地址设置不同的权重值，实现解析查询按照权重比例返回地址

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of DNS records
